steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Segmentation: geo (location), demo (age, gender, income), psycho (lifestyle, values), behavioural (usage, loyalty)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 7 Ps: Product (features, quality, branding), Price (strategies), Place (channels), Promotion (mix), People (service), Process (delivery), Physical evidence (tangibles)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Pricing: penetration (low, gain share), skimming (high, early adopters), psychological (GBP 9.99), competitive (match), cost-plus (markup), dynamic (real-time)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: PLC: introduction, growth, maturity, decline; Extension: new markets, new uses, repositioning

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: A new energy drink targets 18-25 males. Propose segmentation, pricing, and promotion strategy --- Solution: Segmentation: demographic (18-25, male), psychographic (active, risk-takers), behavioural (gym-goers). Pricing: penetration (GBP 1.50) to gain share quickly. Promotion: social media influencers, gym sponsorships, sampling at events. Place: gyms, convenience stores, online subscription

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Segment the electric car market | Compare penetration vs skimming for new iPhone | Design promotional mix for local bakery

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of marketing with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step.
